ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a cylinder cut in half along the length direction: one can see an outer semicylindrical curved surface, a flat rectangular cut surface extending along the height direction of the cylinder, and the semicircular end faces at the two ends; the dashed lines indicate the arc-shaped boundary at the back that is blocked from view. According to the problem, the radius of the cylinder base is r=6 cm, and the height is h=10 cm. Find the total surface area by decomposing it by faces: the area of the semicylindrical curved surface is half of the lateral area of a complete cylinder, that is, (1/2)(2πrh)=πrh=π·6·10=60π. The two semicircular end faces together equal the area of one complete circle, that is, πr^2=π·6^2=36π. The width of the flat rectangular cut surface is the diameter 2r=12 cm, and the height is 10 cm, so the area is 12·10=120. The total surface area is 60π+36π+120=96π+120.

method.method_draft: Use a direct face-by-face surface decomposition. From the image, identify the solid as a longitudinal half-cylinder: it has one curved semicylindrical surface, two semicircular end faces, and one flat rectangular cut face running along the cylinder’s height. From the text, take radius r=6 cm and height h=10 cm. Compute curved area as half the full cylinder lateral area: (1/2)(2πrh)=πrh=60π. Compute the two semicircular ends together as one full circle: πr^2=36π. Compute the rectangular cut face using diameter times height: 2r·h=12·10=120. Add: 60π+36π+120=96π+120.

method.method_draft: Use a full-cylinder comparison. From the image, recognize that the solid is exactly one of two congruent pieces made by slicing a right circular cylinder through its central axis; the slice creates a new flat rectangular face. From the text, use r=6 and h=10. First compute the total surface area of the original full cylinder: 2πr^2+2πrh=2π(6^2)+2π(6)(10)=72π+120π=192π. One half receives exactly half of the original outside surface area, so that contributes 96π. Then add the new exposed rectangular cut face, with dimensions diameter 12 and height 10, giving 120. Total surface area is 96π+120.
